## Over-the-air patches
Patches do NOT use GitHub Actions. `python3 scripts/publish_patch.py` writes `web/` plus a `manifest.json` (build number + file hashes) to the `gh-pages` branch; GitHub Pages serves that branch at `https://sunantongsan.github.io/molt/` (Settings → Pages → Source: **Deploy from a branch**, `gh-pages`, `/ (root)`). The Android app checks it on start, downloads only the changed files and restarts into the new game, no APK reinstall. Changes to the Android code itself (Java, manifest, ads) still need a new APK — the APK workflow is paused and only runs by hand from the Actions tab.
